config_name: Galaxy Book6 16 (refurb-Excellent) — Intel Core Ultra 7 355, Arc iGPU, 16GB LPDDR5X, 512GB, 16" FHD+ touch

battery.notes: Arrow Lake U/H-Low is decent but not Lunar Lake-efficient; ~9-11h light use.

price.notes: REFURB-Excellent: reg $2,099 / $1,469 (BBY-verified 2026-11-24). New 16" Book6 tiers are refurb-only at BBY. Refurb carries BBY return policy; note condition grade. SKU 20280238.

professional.notes: No retrievable pro review; refurb SKU of an under-reviewed line (see SHARED-galaxy-book.md). Honest null.

praises: 16-inch Copilot+ touch laptop for $1,469 refurb — the cheapest big-screen AI PC at BBY
Ultra 7 355 (Arrow Lake) is a solid multitasking chip for office workloads
Numeric keypad + 16:10 touch screen at a value price
Galaxy ecosystem features identical to new units
Refurb-Excellent units come with BBY return protection, low risk
complaints: Refurb only — new 16" Book6 isn't stocked at BBY CA
Dim ~300-nit FHD+ IPS panel; the 16" deserves the AMOLED the Pro 16 has
60 Hz and no Thunderbolt certainty on base-tier 16"
Arrow Lake sprints behind Lunar Lake on battery

design_philosophy: The Book6 16 extends the base chassis to a big 16:10 touch canvas with Arrow Lake silicon, aimed at buyers who want screen area over portability without paying Pro prices. At BBY CA it exists only as a refurb-Excellent SKU — which paradoxically makes it the value play of the 16-inch range, undercutting both the new base line and the AMOLED Pro 16.
rating_notes: Inferred from Book6 14 base synthesis: +2 screen_size / −3 portability for 16", −2 battery (Arrow Lake 355 less efficient than Lunar Lake), touch adds pen_touch 5. Refurb condition noted in price. Bot-wall disclosure in SHARED-galaxy-book.md. Image URL best-guess BBY CDN pattern.
